# Arc Layer

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

An arc per row between two positions.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "arc", "name": "arc", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:widthScale`, or read elsewhere as `ch('arc/widthScale')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `in` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->
